notes.title: Did someone say PS5 physical editions are here?!
notes.notes:

If you have been following our socials, you might have seen some of our updates. We can't wait to share them with you![/p][p][/p][p]👋 Your positive rating means a lot to our small team. If you have enjoyed Copycat, please drop us a review. We love to read them.
[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/58995ac7f54b6ddd48fe913763197614025a6a4a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Alright, first off the ranks is a beautiful review featured in Debug Magazine. Special shout out to this wonderful magazine.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/4e9044931b532ab248b6a0bebf752e2a5a3bf59c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]A few weeks ago, we made a video reflecting on the last four and a half years developing our first indie game Copycat. We are forever grateful.[/p][p][/p][p]😻 Search 'Copycat Game Devlog' on Youtube to watch the video, or follow the link if you are on Desktop:[/p][p][url="https://youtu.be/FQPKsWgM43M" style="button"]https://youtu.be/FQPKsWgM43M[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/a9e9033e652ac945956b1cf50bfca59d921573ec.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]One of our biggest creative challenges was giving a voice to our silent protagonist, Dawn. notes.title: We have a surprise (physical editions are coming!)
notes.notes:
[p]Hi kittens,[/p][p]You have made our hearts soar. We finally hit 'Overwhelming Positive' on Steam for a few days while we had our daily deal. (Hello, friends who have just joined us from the Daily Deal!) 👋 Your positive rating means a lot to our small team.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/0f1d847f650ffe5c48db27132023dc06a3e35b9f.png"][/img][/p][p]We wanted to take some time to reflect on the last six months. We have been part of our second cat shelter charity stream, made it as finalist at an awards show, and have been working on a physical edition (but more on that later).[/p][p][/p][p]We were going through some of our quotes and stumbled across this beautiful one from Thumb Culture (who gave us five stars). Thanks for making our day.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/d7b5f8db6db039dab03d91cf2a254cf5d012061e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Over the easter holidays, the Copycat team had an opportunity to help animal shelters across Spain and Germany. The charity is a non-profit organisation called 'Sieben-Katzenleben e.V' that rescues street cats and rehomes them. A handful of passionate Twitch streamers played Copycat to raise money for the animal shelters. A big thank you to 'Viking Charity' for organising the event.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/ec69d41ae21f2772aa6a2108e360a7a497ea0f63.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Do you have a friend who you think would enjoy Copycat, but doesn't have Steam? From today, you can play Copycat in your browser via your laptop or phone. You don't need a gaming PC—just good internet connection. All is possible thanks to Xsolla and their cloud-based gaming. Play your 15-minute free taster of Copycat by visiting: [url="https://x.la/cgs/copycat"]https://x.la/cgs/copycat[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/85b7244aae3dc97f3518a93a8d2ffb982134953e.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Did anyone make it to gamescom latam BIG Festival in Brazil? We were nominated as a finalist in the category of best 'Social Matters' game. Copycat aims to tell a thought-provoking story that encourages empathy and awareness about pet adoption. Our pets love us unconditionally and are there for us on good days and bad. Please take the best care of them as you can. Remember to hug your pets tightly.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/3da4c4a6617ac2e373f24d57a662d7cb6e14cee9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We have some exciting news. Pre-orders are available for the physical edition Copycat PS5. We partnered with our Spanish friends over at @TesuraGames to make this all possible. Get your paws on a copy! 💙 Pre-order today at the Tesura Store by visiting: [url="https://store.tesuragames.com/producto/copycat-ps5/"]https://store.tesuragames.com/producto/copycat-ps5/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/5ad6b0f9dae7d449ae6057fa04c1435db4317803.jpg"][/img][/p][p]If you enjoyed Copycat on PC, Steam Deck or Mac, make sure to leave us a review. It makes a huge difference to our tiny team.[/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/868f4648db62845f6ffa070b284c125de45614d3.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Big Smiles,[/p][p]Sam, Kostia and Dan[/p]

notes.title: Get your paws on Copycat! (+ Interviews with the dev team)
notes.notes: [p]Hi cool cats,[/p][p]It has been nine months since Copycat launched on PC and almost two months since we launched on Mac. We are so grateful for our Steam community. Thanks for cheering us on![/p][p][/p][p]A big hello to all our new friends joining the Copycat family. Did you grab Copycat on sale at the Cozy and Family Friendly Games Celebration last week? Thank you, Adrian and Rokaplay team for letting us participate two years in a row.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/605669652cce886083abd2e5b59dc782b56a1516.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Copycat was reviewed by the lovely fur-parents at Colin Magazine in Melbourne, Australia. (A big hello to our fellow Victorians 👋). They played our emotional little game, and here's what they had to say: "Copycat is a heartbreaking love letter to lost cats and lonely souls." & "At times, the game feels less like something you’re playing and more like something you’re feeling."[/p][p][/p][p]Read the full review here: [url="https://colinmagazine.com/blogs/news/copycat-review-a-heartbreaking-love-letter-to-lost-cats-and-lonely-souls"]https://colinmagazine.com/blogs/news/copycat-review-a-heartbreaking-love-letter-to-lost-cats-and-lonely-souls[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/264b9ec4228258c9d9c855a653c45aacc1eba58a.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Our writer Sam Cable was interviewed about using sadness as an emotional tool in video games. Journalist Tony Ling did a wonderful job piecing together this story and asking compelling questions such as "Why do sad moments linger long after the console has been switched off?" & "How do games create a safe space for players to process complex themes like grief and loss?".[/p][p][/p][p]Get the full conversation here: [url="https://www.theaureview.com/games/interviews-games/interview-copycat-writer-samantha-cable/"]https://www.theaureview.com/games/interviews-games/interview-copycat-writer-samantha-cable/[/url][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/ced58f2d7a2f6e034c50aac20b14d21ce4b7ee33.jpg"][/img][/p][p]For all our fellow devs and game writers out there, this next podcast might be purrfect watch. Sam had a cheeky feature on a great new podcast called [url="https://www.linkedin.com/company/weinterruptpodcast/"]We Interrupt This Broadcast[/url]. In the interview, Sam shared her thoughts on developing video game narrative that leave you wanting a big hug. The host, Julie Eckersley, asked delightful questions such as "Are there common ingredients that help create an immersive, unforgettable story?" & "How do you design a narrative that gives people real agency while still staying emotionally powerful?" 💛[/p][p][/p][p]A big thanks to the entire team: Julie, Kirsty and Leonie! For the full conversation, tune in into Ep 14 of We Interrupt This Broadcast on Spotify, YouTube and Apple Podcasts.[/p][p][/p][p]Watch on YouTube: [dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KK_goeES6bU"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/d3ce3ae474dd08652cdabcaf9c892a3877d4297d.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Copycat has pounced onto PlayStation 5 and Xbox X/S! If you have played it on PC, but want to bring it to console, now is your chance. Ready your controllers for a short, emotional catventure about love, loss, and the meaning of home. Get your paws on a copy! 💙 💚[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/9ea20c00af640d5d1fa71bdc8bd18a9a7e62c19f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dawn is waiting for you to leave a Steam review. If you enjoyed Copycat, make sure to leave us a review. It makes a huge difference to our tiny team.[/p][p][/p][p]Big Smiles,[/p][p]Sam, Kostia and Dan[/p]

notes.title: Vote for Copycat at the Steam Awards
notes.notes:
Hi kittens, the Steam Awards nominations are open. It would mean the world to us if you could nominate our little game for the 'outstanding story-rich game' award! ❤️ 

Thanks again for all your continued support.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/b01b309bdcf5fd2637376e21e67a4fcb8b19ae03.png[/img]


Did you know 30,000 people have played Copycat? Here's what some people have been saying:


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/c50f3cbd0d3d2cfd11b4317a87cafcd7ac31910c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/6e28150dd1d3abc3f1d6e6c59d0655386fe8d3ee.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/174ba2399d5a7c5b4f453f6737b8bbaeea44c2cc.png[/img]


What is Copycat about?
Copycat is a poignant narrative-driven game about rejection and belonging. It is about a pet who learns to deal with abandonment, and a human forced to surrender. Together, two souls go on a journey to discover the meaning of family and home. The game's colourful visuals delight the senses while exploring dark thematic depths. Journey on an emotional rollercoaster that pulls at the heartstrings and reminds you how it feels to be left behind. 

Copycat uses the medium of a narrative-led video game to make a sincere comment on pet abandonment and animal surrender. It's fully voice-acted, featuring hours of dialogue and a talented voice cast. Celebrate the moments of bringing a pet home for the first time, and learn how cats can improve the mental health of their owners. Copycat has an accessible surface story while delivering profound philosophical lessons to catch audiences off-guard. 


Big Smiles,
Sam & Kostia

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/c276b6e4d936167ae5f456984125d5111943f535.jpg[/img]

Copycat’s delightful soundtrack is also available for USD $3.99. Our composer Daniel Bunting had this to say about the music: 

"The expansive and lushly cinematic score of "Copycat" gives voice to our non-verbal (but profusely meowing) protagonist. It sings cuddly lullabies, vulnerable kalimbas, and fiercely independent jazz escapades, yet its raw and primal energy speaks loudest of all.

Initially, the score is comedic and stylized, with thunderous tribal percussion accompanying battles against butterflies and pan-fried steak. However, as the stakes escalate and the conflict turns real and existential, the score continues to reflect the philosophical narrative on a primal and emotional level.

It's rare to juxtapose a philosophical narrative with a primal score—just as rare as delving into the mind of a cat."


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/69b102d465e8a9a53feab36b9980c102b60045dd.png[/img]

notes.title: ‘Copycat’ is up for adoption September 19 & 20 on PC
notes.notes:
Hi kittens,
Help Copycat find a new home on your PC this September 19 (US/EU) and 20 (AUS/NZ). Experience love, loneliness and letting go in our narrative-driven adventure game. Share the news with your animal-loving friends.


Check out our brand-new release date trailer:
[previewyoutube=QfODF74EPzI;full][/previewyoutube]

Copycat Key Features

💛 Story from the heart: Copycat disguises itself as a simple story about a cat trying to discover where she truly belongs, but underneath lies a philosophical narrative layer that will make you pause and feel. It asks questions about our own existence and place in the world. 

🌻 Animal expert as your conscience: Play as a domestic housecat while a nature documentary narrates your every move. 

🐈 See the world through cat eyes: Climb trees, fight dogs, and explore the neighbourhood with intuitive, smooth cat-like controls. Make mischief, knock things on the ground, hide in boxes, run through the long grass, and meow at everything that moves.

🎮 Guided by your moral compass: Reflect on themes of home, loneliness and belonging through a complex, three-act story told effortlessly through three hours of video game narrative. 

🎤 Voiced with passion: Copycat is fully voice-acted featuring hours of dialogue with a talented cast. 

🎹 Music to your ears: Experience a diverse score spanning jazz, lullaby music and tribal music. Heartwarming original score composed by Daniel Bunting. 

🪴 Enjoy atmospheric locations: Including the cozy family house, sunkissed backyard, creepy alleyways, and lush national parks. 

🇦🇺 A touch of Australia: Made with local voices and locations under the Australian sun.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/a6ecda63713764a7ad9eafb016229c6ffb5fa21a.png[/img]

What people have been saying

“Tears will flow the further you sink your claws in.”
- TechRadar

“A complex, moving narrative experience.”
- Gameshub

“It leaves you with a lump in your throat.”
- Indie Games Devel

"Copycat is more than a game; it’s a story of love, resilience, and the unbreakable bonds that make us feel at home, anywhere."
- Overage Gaming


Also a big hello to our South Korean friends. Copycat enjoyed out time at Busan Indie Connect Festival.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/68981d6715d428a90e759bcc4b3ce8d52b4da522.jpg[/img]


Big Smiles,
Sam and Kostia

notes.title: Copycat is coming to Steam Next Fest
notes.notes:
Hey Kittens, 
The demo of Copycat is finally out in the big wide world! And the demo is coming to Steam Next Fest!

[b]In case you missed it: [/b]Copycat is a wholesome, narrative-driven game about rejection, belonging and the true meaning of home. It follows the story of a newly adopted shelter cat who becomes the victim of an elaborate plan when a jealous, stray copycat steals her place in the household.

The demo will take you around 45 minutes to complete. Purrfect for one sitting. Make sure you have a cup of tea close by and something small and fluffy to cuddle. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/1fef10c55ade4352407a1bde52ca49fdd7b9feba.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/b7c8a12d8fa8b7279054ccf5b994cee2d2cba45e.jpg[/img]

Our friends at Kotaku Australia have taken the time to play a demo of Copycat! David Smith has kindly written a thoughtful preview ahead of Steam Next Fest happening Feb 5th. We feel a sense of pride for our little game. Check out some of David's quotes for a deep dive.

🐈 "The Copycat demo is a smart, effective springboard to a game that feels like it has big ideas to communicate. I look forward to playing the full (and likely altogether more traumatic) full game in the future."

💛 "Within this one-hour demo, Copycat demonstrates an understanding of the relationship between cat and owner."

🐾 "Just when she thought she had a home, Dawn finds herself thrown out on the street and embarks on a journey of her own about what home truly means."

Hi friends, 
This is the perfect early 30th birthday present! Last week we received our first official interview for our indie game Copycat in the lead-up to PAX Australia. Tony did a terrific job wrangling the article together. Read the full article here: https://eziyoda.com/2023/08/16/genre-of-cats-chat-with-team-behind-copycat/

Kostia and I have an opportunity to reflect on our journey, and realised that thanks to our years in advertising, we now have the hustle, the fire, the storytelling skills and the technical abilities to thrive in game development.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/5457c6b038b34d51a46965491688a79c11d4944c.png[/img]

Follow our socials for more updates on Copycat as we approach PAX. Or head on over to EZIYODA (https://eziyoda.com/) for more loveable long-form opinion pieces usually involving games or cats.

See below a sneak peek of the article:

"TONY: When people experience Copycat firsthand at PAX Aus, what are you hoping their takeaway will be?

SAM: We want them to turn to their partner, their friend, or their animal, and just give them a big hug!

KOSTIA: We want to try to shift more public perception, to show that video games are not just a bunch of violent shooting and robbing games, but they have beauty, they have storytelling.

SAM: They have a soul."

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/734105cf4ca1433ffb0897e9263bbb305ef2d021.png[/img]

"TONY: Are there any real-life pets that might be making cameos in-game?

SAM: Oh yes, there’s so many! Flame, our family cat, is the voiceover for about 80% of the game.

KOSTIA: Last Christmas break, when we were with the family, we were stalking the poor cat for three days with a microphone, like, “Please meow! Please meow!”. We have a few friends from Twitter and a few streamers that kindly offered us their help in terms of cat sounds. We have two people sending us cat sounds to use in the game." Legends.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/45c415674f8f19effa267ec9bb0c410170e05be2.jpg[/img]

Sam & Kostia

notes.title: Meet the team 🎮
notes.notes:
We're Sam and Kostia, a Kiwi and a Ukrainian, first-time game makers and full-time creatives. But we also happily hold the titles of innovators, articulators, and mischief-makers. 

Welcome to our gaming collective called Spoonful of Wonder. Here you can find us tinkering on our debut game 'Copycat' and drinking tea. Our vision is to develop video games that ignite imagination, spark nostalgia and speak to the soul. Our creative practice sits at the alchemy of optimism, metaphor and magic—with the ambition to unearth the stronger side of humanity. We believe every game needs a spoonful of the sweet stuff.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/72e7b24ac41613fc29246659758fc8b15223c95c.jpg[/img]

🐾 Meet Sam / Head of Narrative
Sam is a vibrant writer who specialises in stories for video games, animation and comic books. Her creative portfolio has won her title of 'Young Creative of the Year' at ADC Europe. Sam holds a Masters in Screenwriting from the Australian Film Television and Radio School where she has returned as a guest lecturer. Sam is a 2022 award jury member for the gaming category of the Art Directors Club in New York.

🐾 Meet Kostia / Head of Art
Kostia has over 10 years of experience in commercial creativity where he polished his directing, innovation, and design craft; winning over 100 international art direction awards including Cannes Lions, D&AD and New York Festivals. In addition to speaking English, German, Ukrainian and Russian, Kostia is also fluent in Unity 3D, Blender, After Effects, FMOD, Reallusion iClone and Photoshop.

notes.title: Happy Holidays & Here's To Exciting 2023!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hi friends! [/h1]

Sam & Kostia here, a tiny 2 person team working our butts of to bring Copycat to life. If you're reading this, you're one of the amazing humans who motivate us to make the best game we can and never give up. We wanted to give you a tiny update on Copycat and share our plans for the coming year :)

[h2][b]Bye, 2022[/b][/h2]

Standing at 25,000+ wishlists strong, last year was huge for Copycat development. From some rough mechanics and basic level blocking, we went to a fully playable demo with great voice acting, exciting narrative, lovely music and better visuals. The demo now is in active closed testing with our friends & family - it's important we get a couple of rounds of feedback and fix things before we show the game to you. It already brought up many very useful points that we successfully implemented in the game. If testing the demo is something you'd be interested - please stay tuned, we'll be announcing a round of small public testing early next year.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/9c185dc6cbeea1718045fadbfaa4385db3f08042.jpg[/img] 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/a6e094b5d4cc23100b8709531628b935a9651c7c.jpg[/img]

We also finally registered a company! Partially because we hope to be in game dev for a long run, and partially because of some of the funding opportunities we're holding out fingers crossed for, we registered a proprietary limited creative collective "Spoonful of Wonder". 

[h2][b]Hi, 2023[/b][/h2]

What's next for the game? Well, first of all, we'll take a couple of weeks of to spend time with family, cuddle the family cat and actually play some games. The idea of game developers who don't play many games sounds kinda ridiculous, but making a game really takes all your free time, play time included. This holiday season Kostia will spend some time finally giving the masterpiece Horizon Zero Dawn a shot, while Sam is catching them all in the newest game from the Pokemon franchise. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/3c73e98f9a6fef043c88a29465271df4b057eea8.jpg[/img]

Speaking of free time - if you followed us on socials, you probably know we worked in advertising as our day jobs while developing Copycat in our free time. Well, that won't be the case for much longer - in 2023 we're taking a "leap of faith". We both resigned from our agency jobs and will work on Copycat full time! As much as we'll miss our lovely team in the advertising world, we really want to give this game all we got and going full time game dev is a move we wanted to do for a long time. Super excited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40457693/5b10b6a442be2ce18dc521b90118d6007378a876.jpg[/img]

Hope you have a lovely holiday break and get to enjoy this time with your loved ones. We'll do our best to make these updates frequent and keep you up to date with our progress. Please let us know if you want to learn about anything in particular, we're always here and always exciting to hear from you!

[i]Big smiles,
Sam & Kostia
Spoonful of Wonder[/i]
